SINDH ACT NO. I OF 1996
THE SIND REGISTRATION OF GODOWNS ACT, 1995.
[15TH January, 1996]

AN ACT to provide for the registration of godowns in the 
Province of Sindh.
Preamble.

WHEREAS it is expedient in the Public interest to provide 
for the registration of godowns in the Province of Sindh.
It is hereby enacted as follows :—

Short title and 
commencement.

1. 
(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Registration of 
Godowns Act, 1995.
(2) It shall extent to the whole of the Province of Sindh.
(3) It shall come into force at once.
Definition.

2. 
In this act, unless there is anything repugnant in the 
subject or context—

(i) 
“essential article” means an article declared as 
such by Government; 
 
(ii) 
“godown” means premises used for storing of an 
essential article and includes ware house, cold 
storage or depot;

(iii) 
“Government” means the Government of Sindh;

(iv) 
“Owner” means an owner of a godown and 
includes the person having the management of a 
godown;

(vi) 
“Registering Authority” means the Director General 
Bureau of supply and Prices or any other officer 
appointed as such by Government.

Stocking of 
essential articles.

3. 
No essential article shall be stored or stocked in a 
godown unless the godown is registered in accordance with the 
provinces of this Act.

Registration of 
Godown

4. 
(1) 
The 
owner 
shall, 
within 
thirty 
days 
of 
the 
commencement of this Act, in the case of a godown already in 
existence and within sixty days of the construction or establishment of 
new godown, make  application to the Registering Authority in the 
prescribed form for registration of his godown. 
 
 
(2) The Registring Authority, on receipt of the application 
shall make such inquiries, and reqire the owner to furnish such 
information as he consider necessary.
SINDH ACT NO. I OF 1996
THE SIND REGISTRATION OF GODOWNS ACT, 1995.

(3) If the Registering Authority as a result of such inquiry 
made by it, is satisfied that the information contained in the 
application or furnished by the owner in respect of his godown is 
correct, it shall register the godown. 
 
 
(4) The owner whose godown is registered shall be 
responsible for due compliance with the provinces of this Act and the 
rules and with the directions, if any, issued to him by the Registering 
Authority in respect of the godown or the essential article stored 
therein.

Maintenance and 
inspection of 
records.

5. 
The owner shall maintain and produce for inspection of 
such books, accounts and record relating to the essential articles 
stored in or removed from the godown and to furnish such 
information relating thereto as may be required by the Registering 
Authority.
Power of search.

6. 
The Registering Authority may enter and search the 
godown registered under this Act and seize any essential article in 
respect of which the Authority has reasons to believe that the 
information furnished by the owner is not correct or the directions 
issued by the Registering Authority are being or are about to be 
contravened.
Appeal.

7. 
Any person aggrieved by an order of the Registering 
Authority, may within thirty days of the order appeal to Government 
and the orders passed by the Government there on shall be final.
Penalty.

8. 
Whoever contravenes any provision of this Act or order 
made or directions given by the Registering Authority shall be 
punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one 
year or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees.

Power to make 
rules.

9. 
Government may make rules to give effect to the 
provisions of this Act.

10. 
The Sindh Registration of Godowns Ordinance, 1995, is 
hereby repealed.

Repeal of Sindh 
Ordinance X of 
1995.
